clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This standard prescribes requirements for extracted honey intended for direct consumption. It covers floral honey, honeydew honey, and blended honey. ISI certification is available for honey under BIS Scheme I.

clauses.title: Requirements for Honey
clauses.text:
Requirements for extracted honey:
- Moisture content: Not more than 20% by mass
- Total reducing sugars: Not less than 65%
- Sucrose: Not more than 5%
- Ash: Not more than 0.5%
- Fiehe's test: Negative (indicates adulteration with sugar syrup)
- Aniline chloride test: Negative (indicates invert sugar adulteration)
- HMF (Hydroxymethylfurfural): Not more than 80 mg/kg
- Honey shall be free from artificial flavouring, colouring matter, and any other food additives.
